clauses.why: The verse says all who dwelt there saw him and turned to the Lord; the healing is in verses 33-34, so cite them, and the clause is trimmed to the people's turning.
clauses.english: saw all its people turn to the Lord after Peter healed Aeneas

clauses.spa: todos sus habitantes se convirtieron al Señor después de que Pedro sanó a Eneas
